title: Emergency Contraception (Morning-After Pill)
aliases: unprotected sex er por ki korbo
summary: Emergency contraception can prevent pregnancy after unprotected sex or a condom failure. Levonorgestrel pills (e.g. Plan B, i-pill) work best within 72 hours; ulipristal (ella) and a copper IUD work up to 5 days.
key_points: The sooner it's taken, the better it works.
It works mainly by delaying ovulation; it is not an abortion pill.
It's for emergencies, not regular contraception, and doesn't protect against STIs.
answer_guidance: Be calm and practical — the user may be worried. Give the time window clearly and suggest a pharmacist/doctor.
